result.reason: The added clause assigns Client the Support Services results and work product, preserves TrueLink’s pre-existing and independently developed IP, grants the required perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free embedded-IP licence with fallback-consistent use, modification and sublicensing rights, confirms Client ownership of its content and data, and disclaims joint ownership. It leaves TrueLink’s Interface ownership and existing Credit Data licence intact. Drafting is generally professional, although “all data ... generated through” is potentially broad, the reference to Section 8(d) should be verified, and the margin comment inaccurately describes the embedded-IP licence as a “licence back.”
